name: ride-complete-three-stops
ride-night
js: (() => {const a=window.__CITY_APP; if(!a.rideFeatured('504')) throw new Error('Could not start night ride');})()

name: ride-pagehide-saves-ground-and-ends
ride-mode-cleanup
js: (() => {const a=window.__CITY_APP; if(!a.rideFeatured('504')) throw new Error('Could not restart ride'); a.selectMode('car'); if(a.streetcarRide.active||a.controllerManager.suspended||a.cameraSystem.followOverride||!a.controllerManager.getActiveEntity().mesh.visible) throw new Error('Mode cancellation failed'); console.log('[ride-check] mode change restores controls');})()

name: ride-teleport-cleanup
js: (() => {const a=window.__CITY_APP; if(!a.rideFeatured('504')) throw new Error('Could not restart ride'); a.teleportTo(-1000,-350,1.57); if(a.streetcarRide.active||a.controllerManager.suspended) throw new Error('Teleport cancellation failed'); console.log('[ride-check] teleport releases passenger lease');})()
